summary: The engine: an embedded database for browsers that runs in a Web Worker, keeps data in OPFS and runs plans. It carries no language: SQL is smaltql's.
responsibilities: The client (open(), Database) on the main thread, talking to the engine worker over the protocol in src/shared/
Planning and execution, B-trees, the pager and WAL, the catalog, the VFS, and the worker server and runtime
The plugin interface (plugin API version 1 is stable: additive changes only, or a new version; ADR 0013)
smaltdb/language: what a language needs from the engine; a change smaltql needs lands here first
notes: Plugins live in their own repositories (ADR 0012); core never imports one.
SQL in tests, benchmarks and browser tests comes from the @smaltworks/smaltql pin in packed.json.

traces.name: Opening a database
traces.about: From open() on the main thread to the engine worker, its server and the files in OPFS. Each step is an import or a worker start in the code.

steps.note: open(name, options) on the main thread: the client API
Starts the engine worker: new Worker(new URL('./smaltdb-worker.js', import.meta.url))
The worker's entry point, built to smaltdb-worker.js (the ./worker export)
The worker runtime: sets up the VFS, plugins and the server
The messages the client and the worker exchange
Where the data lives: files in the Origin Private File System
